# iximiuz-labs_challenge (Resource)

Manages an iximiuz-labs challenge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iximiuz-labs_challenge" "example" {
  name_prefix = "my-challenge"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) A name prefix for the challenge. The API will append a unique suffix to produce the final `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the challenge was created.
- `name` (String) The challenge name (slug), assigned by the server.
- `page_url` (String) The challenge web URL.
- `title` (String) The challenge display title.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the challenge was last updated.
